               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog</rs> gi zhal nas sgrub pa'i thal 'gyur bya ba bzlog pa rang rgyud dang 'brel ba yin <lb n="9.9"/> pa la | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">sngon gyi bshad pa po rnams</rs> kyi de bzlog pa dang ma 'brel bas <?oxy_comment_start comment="[bold face in source document]"?>bsgrub pa'i thabs 'gyur<?oxy_comment_end?> gyi mtshan nyid ni khyab pa dngos po la gnas pa phyogs chos khas blangs su 'dug pa skabs su bab pa'i dam bca la tshad ma'i bsal ba byung ba la bzhed do ||</seg></TEI>
